message.content: According to the conversation, Wolfgang Schulz expressed interest in adding the song "Viva la Vida" by Coldplay to their set list for their next jam session. He specifically mentioned that the song was super popular and that the crowd usually loved it, making it a good choice to add to their repertoire. Wolfgang also noted that the song's energetic nature would enhance their performance and that it was a fun one to play on the drums. Wolfgang and Li Hua agreed that it would be a great choice for their upcoming session.
